candidate.definition_en: A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant.
candidate.explanation_ar: إجراء بتاخده بدري عشان تمنع أي مشكلة أو خطر ممكن يحصل.

senses.definition_en: A measure taken in advance to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant.
senses.explanation_ar: إجراء احترازي أو وقائي يتم اتخاذه مسبقًا لتفادي ضرر أو خطر محتمل.
examples: As a precaution, I locked the door before leaving the house.
The team took every precaution to ensure the laboratory was safe.
Wearing a seatbelt is a simple precaution that can save your life.

candidate.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' 'حذر'.. و 'Pre' 'قبل'.. يعني بتاخد حذرك من قبل ما المشكلة تحصل.
